m: भ्लाश् (connected with √ भ्राश्), cl. 1. Ā. 4. भ्लाशते, ˚श्यते (pf. बभ्लाशे, or भ्लेशे &c.), to shine, beam, glitter, Dhātup. xix, 77.

भ्लक्ष् (v.l. for √ भक्ष्) cl. 1. P. Ā. भ्लक्षति, ˚ते, to eat, Dhātup. xxi, 27.

s: Ya BakzaRe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰uBa॰-saka॰-sew .) antaHsTatftIyopaDaH । Ya Blakzati Blakzate । lasTAne saptamasvara iti durgasiMhaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: BakzaRe BvA॰ uBa॰ saka॰ sew । Blakzati te aBlakzIt aBlakzizwa । durganate BrakzaDAturayam ।
